title: Tea - supplied reading passage

pages.text:
"Yes, yes", said the mouse. 
"I will make us a pot of tea". 

She hung up the phone.
She put the teapot on the stove.
She set out the cups.
She swept the little house.

Toad felt happy.
He a sang a little.
